scope: 只读数值设计稿；22名已接入守军×T1/T2/T3，共66份；9名树海独立配置；3个备援派生；6类不可被单独攻击的效果。无Unity/项目修改。
assumptions: T1/T2/T3为本作关卡强度档，不是合成星级；原作稀有度与玩家怪物合成星级分开。
以13关完整挑战为主，1/2/5/9/12为保送补给关，无守军且DPS通过阈值0；3/4用T1，6用T2低压精英，7/8用T2，10用T2精英组合，11用T3普通，13用T3有限精英组合。
原作稀有度只按本地明确文字核实：D07/D09/D10三星，D21~D30六星；D01~D06/D08/D11/D12未找到明确字段，列未核实，不据记忆猜。
玩家护甲按现有基值0~24，每星+2；常规核算样本0/12/30。法术以0/20/40法抗样本复核，精英特殊护盾/复起另算。
现有防守方没有独立逐干员基础法抗字段，基础法抗来自当前对局CombatSettings.Effects.Resistance。本建议全普通守军基础法抗0，圣聆初雪常态保留额外20。若未来逐单位配置法抗，需要工程接口变更；此稿未伪称已实现。
保留普通攻击前摇/动作时长/间隔、站位身份、半径范围、阻挡；所有技能时钟与暂停沿用现有规则。
技能参数里部分在现有代码硬编码；这里是重新设计的目标值，不能仅改资产就宣称已生效。
无战斗倒计时；下方公式窗口只用于测量火力和治疗压力，不引入超时失败。

formulas.singleTargetDps: sum(expected independent hit damage per action) / effective interval
formulas.effectiveInterval: ordinaryInterval / attackSpeedMultiplier; keep complete animation at the same configured speed
formulas.kroosCycle: 4 ordinary attacks then a double empowered attack; crit separately each arrow, armor separately each arrow
formulas.stewardCycle: 4 ordinary arts attacks then one 1.9x arts attack, so sustained pre-resistance modifier=(4+1.9)/5=1.18
formulas.medicHps: healingAttack / healingInterval; only actual missing HP counts
formulas.mon3trChainTotalHps: attack / 2.833333 * (1+0.75+0.75^2), if three distinct wounded legal targets
formulas.forestProtectionDebt: normalSkillHp = baseHP*healthMultiplier; debtBudget = normalSkillHp*debtMaxHealthMultiplier; final protection is time-window pressure, not extra finite HP

validation.method: executed Python structural and independent formula checks; deterministic; no random model

checks.name: all implemented distinct IDs covered exactly

one or two low-cost 2-star kill ordinary T1 before first death in simplified opening
Mon3tr field positive while effective time recharge zero, matches current validator and runtime
rarity unknown kept explicit for nine locally-unverified originals
all skill SP initial <= required and finite nonnegative parameters
D25 finite budget uses skill MaxHealth once plus debt, not base twice
